claims.title: Rise of the Principality of Polotsk
claims.summary: The Krivichi formed a principality around Polotsk on the Western Dvina, the oldest centre of statehood on Belarusian soil and an early constituent of Kievan Rus with a strong tradition of autonomy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-850-rise-of-the-principality-of-polotsk, claim TL:BLR:event:850:rise-of-the-principality-of-polotsk, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Christianization of the Rus lands
claims.summary: The conversion of Kievan Rus to Orthodox Christianity in the late tenth century bound Polotsk and the Belarusian lands to Byzantine Christendom and its written, ecclesiastical culture.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-988-christianization-of-the-rus-lands, claim TL:BLR:event:988:christianization-of-the-rus-lands, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Vseslav of Polotsk seizes Kiev
claims.summary: Prince Vseslav of Polotsk, the principality's most celebrated ruler, briefly held the throne of Kiev itself, a measure of Polotsk's ambition and its rivalry with the senior princes of Rus.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1068-vseslav-of-polotsk-seizes-kiev, claim TL:BLR:event:1068:vseslav-of-polotsk-seizes-kiev, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Mongol invasion of Rus
claims.summary: The Mongol onslaught destroyed Kievan Rus and shattered the old federation of principalities; the western Belarusian lands, comparatively sheltered, were soon drawn into the orbit of rising Lithuania.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1240-the-mongol-invasion-of-rus, claim TL:BLR:event:1240:the-mongol-invasion-of-rus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belarusian lands within the Grand Duchy
claims.summary: Over the 150 years after the Mongol invasion the Grand Duchy of Lithuania expanded to absorb the Belarusian lands, whose Ruthenian (Old Belarusian) tongue became the chancery language of the state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1392-belarusian-lands-within-the-grand-duchy, claim TL:BLR:event:1392:belarusian-lands-within-the-grand-duchy, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Skaryna prints the first East Slavic book
claims.summary: Francysk Skaryna, born in Polotsk, issued his Psalter from his press in Prague, the first book printed in an East Slavic language, followed by further biblical books in 1517-1519.

sources.label: Francysk Skaryna and the First Printed Books in the GDL

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1517-skaryna-prints-the-first-east-slavic-book, claim TL:BLR:event:1517:skaryna-prints-the-first-east-slavic-book, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: A printing press in Vilnius
claims.summary: Moving his workshop to Vilnius, capital of the Grand Duchy, Skaryna produced the Little Travel Book and later The Apostle, the first books printed within the Grand Duchy of Lithuania itself.

sources.label: Francysk Skaryna and the First Printed Books in the GDL

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1522-a-printing-press-in-vilnius, claim TL:BLR:event:1522:a-printing-press-in-vilnius, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Mir Castle and the Radziwiłł magnates
claims.summary: The Gothic castle at Mir, begun in the 1520s and rebuilt in Renaissance style under the Radziwiłł family, became one of the great fortified residences of the Grand Duchy and is now a UNESCO World Heritage site.

sources.label: Architectural, Residential and Cultural Complex of the Radziwill Family at Nesvizh

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1520-mir-castle-and-the-radziwill-magnates, claim TL:BLR:event:1520:mir-castle-and-the-radziwill-magnates, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Union of Lublin and the Commonwealth
claims.summary: The Union of Lublin merged Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, placing the Belarusian lands at the heart of a vast federal state and accelerating the Polonisation of their elites.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1569-union-of-lublin-and-the-commonwealth, claim TL:BLR:event:1569:union-of-lublin-and-the-commonwealth, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Partitions of Poland and Russian annexation
claims.summary: In three partitions Russia, Prussia and Austria divided the Commonwealth; Russia took most of the Belarusian lands, and after 1795 all of Belarus was ruled by the Russian Empire.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1772-partitions-of-poland-and-russian-annexation, claim TL:BLR:event:1772:partitions-of-poland-and-russian-annexation, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Suppression of the Uniate Church and Russification
claims.summary: The Uniate (Greek Catholic) Church was abolished and absorbed into Russian Orthodoxy, part of a sustained imperial policy of Russification that discouraged the Belarusian language and name.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1839-suppression-of-the-uniate-church-and, claim TL:BLR:event:1839:suppression-of-the-uniate-church-and, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Struve Geodetic Arc
claims.summary: Five of the surviving station points of the Struve Geodetic Arc, the first accurate measurement of a long meridian segment carried out across the empire between 1816 and 1855, lie in Belarus and are inscribed by UNESCO.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1816-the-struve-geodetic-arc, claim TL:BLR:event:1816:the-struve-geodetic-arc, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Nasha Niva and the national awakening
claims.summary: The newspaper Nasha Niva, published in Vilnius from 1906, became the platform of the Belarusian national revival, carrying the early work of the poets Yanka Kupala and Yakub Kolas.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1906-nasha-niva-and-the-national-awakening, claim TL:BLR:event:1906:nasha-niva-and-the-national-awakening, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belarusian People's Republic proclaimed
claims.summary: Under German occupation, the Rada in Minsk proclaimed the independence of the Belarusian People's Republic, the first modern declaration of Belarusian statehood, though it never controlled the territory and was soon driven into exile.

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1918-belarusian-people-s-republic-proclaimed, claim TL:BLR:event:1918:belarusian-people-s-republic-proclaimed, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding of the Byelorussian SSR
claims.summary: As the Germans withdrew, the Bolsheviks announced the Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic; in 1922 it became one of the four founding republics of the Soviet Union.

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1919-founding-of-the-byelorussian-ssr, claim TL:BLR:event:1919:founding-of-the-byelorussian-ssr, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of Riga partitions Belarus
claims.summary: The treaty ending the Polish-Soviet War divided Belarus between Poland and Soviet Russia along the line of the first partition; western Belarus went to Poland and the east became the Byelorussian SSR.

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1921-treaty-of-riga-partitions-belarus, claim TL:BLR:event:1921:treaty-of-riga-partitions-belarus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Stalinist terror and Kurapaty
claims.summary: Amid forced collectivisation, the NKVD carried out mass executions of Belarusians at Kurapaty near Minsk between 1937 and 1941; the mass graves, revealed in 1988, became the emblem of Soviet repression in Belarus.

sources.label: Kurapaty (1937-1941): NKVD Mass Killings in Soviet Belarus
sources.publisher: Sciences Po Mass Violence and Resistance Research Network

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1937-stalinist-terror-and-kurapaty, claim TL:BLR:event:1937:stalinist-terror-and-kurapaty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reunification of western Belarus
claims.summary: Following the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact and the German invasion of Poland, Soviet forces entered eastern Poland and western Belarus was annexed to the Byelorussian SSR, reuniting the Belarusian lands.

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1939-reunification-of-western-belarus, claim TL:BLR:event:1939:reunification-of-western-belarus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Nazi occupation and mass death
claims.summary: The German occupation killed a quarter to a third of the population; the people of Belarus fell from about 9.2 million before the war to roughly 6.3 million by late 1944, with cities like Minsk left in ruins.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1941-nazi-occupation-and-mass-death, claim TL:BLR:event:1941:nazi-occupation-and-mass-death, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Khatyn massacre
claims.summary: German forces and auxiliaries burned the village of Khatyn with its inhabitants, one of hundreds of Belarusian villages annihilated in anti-partisan reprisals and a lasting symbol of the occupation's brutality.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1943-the-khatyn-massacre, claim TL:BLR:event:1943:the-khatyn-massacre, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Founding member of the United Nations
claims.summary: In recognition of the Belarusian people's role in defeating fascism, the Byelorussian SSR signed the UN Charter at San Francisco in 1945, becoming a founding member of the United Nations despite not being an independent state.

sources.label: History of Belarus at the United Nations
sources.publisher: Permanent Mission of the Republic of Belarus to the UN

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1945-founding-member-of-the-united-nations, claim TL:BLR:event:1945:founding-member-of-the-united-nations, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Chernobyl disaster
claims.summary: The reactor explosion at Chernobyl in Ukraine sent about 70 percent of its radioactive fallout onto Belarus, contaminating nearly a quarter of the country's territory and affecting some 2.2 million people.

sources.label: Fallout from Chernobyl disaster still a 'very important challenge' for Belarus

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1986-the-chernobyl-disaster, claim TL:BLR:event:1986:the-chernobyl-disaster, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence of Belarus
claims.summary: After declaring sovereignty on 27 July 1990, the Supreme Soviet gave the declaration constitutional force on 25 August 1991 in the wake of the Moscow coup, proclaiming the independent Republic of Belarus.

sources.label: Declaration of State Sovereignty of Belarus (1990)
sources.publisher: International Constitutional Law / University of Bern

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1991-independence-of-belarus, claim TL:BLR:event:1991:independence-of-belarus, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Belavezha Accords dissolve the USSR
claims.summary: In the Belavezha forest in Belarus, part of the UNESCO-listed Belovezhskaya Pushcha, the leaders of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus, including Stanislau Shushkevich, signed accords declaring that the USSR had ceased to exist and founding the Commonwealth of Independent States.

sources.label: Belarus: The emergence of the Belorussian S.S.R.

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1991-belavezha-accords-dissolve-the-ussr, claim TL:BLR:event:1991:belavezha-accords-dissolve-the-ussr, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Lukashenka elected president
claims.summary: Alyaksandr Lukashenka won Belarus's first presidential election on an anti-corruption platform and went on to consolidate authoritarian rule and forge ever-deeper ties with Russia.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1994-lukashenka-elected-president, claim TL:BLR:event:1994:lukashenka-elected-president, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty on the Union State with Russia
claims.summary: Lukashenka and Yeltsin signed a Treaty on the Creation of a Union State, a blueprint for deep Russian-Belarusian integration that has bound the two countries ever closer.

sources.label: Treaty on the Creation of a Union State

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Belarus: A borderland of Europe, from the Principality of Polotsk and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania to a sovereign republic in Russia's orbit.", terralore.co/country/BLR/chronicle#ev-1999-treaty-on-the-union-state-with-russia, claim TL:BLR:event:1999:treaty-on-the-union-state-with-russia, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Disputed election and mass protests
claims.summary: Lukashenka's claimed landslide re-election sparked the largest protests in Belarusian history; the EU declared the vote neither free nor fair and refused to recognise his mandate, while he held on with Russian support.

sources.label: Belarus: Declaration by the High Representative on the so-called 'inauguration' of Lukashenko
